captions.text: Every morning starts here.
Six big buttons for what you do most.
Unfinished things wait here for you.
Small fixes. No panic.
And what’s live on the website.
A green dot up here means all is well.
Lost? Two keys, anywhere. (Ctrl + K on Windows.)
Type a couple’s name…
…or a job. Press return, and you’re there.
Five steps. Any order you like.
Watch the preview: it types along with you.
The page address writes itself.
It saves itself as a draft. Drafts never go live.
Three photos, each with its own shape.
Too small? The Studio says no. Politely.
Click on the couple. Keep faces above the pale band.
Drop 50 or 60 at once. Then drag to reorder.
Every photo needs a description. Yes, every one.
Allow 10 to 15 minutes. Put some music on.
A line for the card, and their story.
Films are YouTube links. Each with its 16:9 poster.
One switch puts them on the homepage.
Not sure what’s left? The bar always knows.
Click anything on it, and it takes you there.
Then check the desktop view. Only you can see drafts.
And now, the big moment.
It takes a few minutes. Keep working if you like.
Live on the website. Well done, you.
Then look at it on your phone. Always.
Nothing you take down is lost. Switch it back on any time.
That one’s for the owner only.
